subject: Quota-driven HC approval + comp-band exception for Q3 SE hires
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quota-driven HC request + comp-band exceptions (Q3)

Marissa / Vivek —

Quick summary: inbound quota shifts from two enterprise accounts and a strong forecast in EMEA triggered an urgent need to re-prioritize Q3 GTM headcount. Pipeline shows an accelerated ramp for three mid-market deals that require immediate SE support; if we don’t add coverage we risk missing committed ARR.

Asking for approval to open the following reqs and to approve two narrow comp-band exceptions for specific senior SE candidates we expect to convert this week:
- 2 x Senior Solutions Engineers (reqs SE-342, SE-343) — market is competing; recommended base band + $10k band exception for one candidate (candidate A) and +$7k for candidate B.
- 1 x AE (mid-market) — standard band.
- 1 x CS Manager (conversion from SDR capacity) — reallocated from an AE headcount if approved.

Rationale: the expected incremental ARR over next 12 months from the targeted deals is $1.2M; breakeven within 8 months once these deals close. I attached the HC request workbook and the comp exception forms for each candidate. Interviews finish this week — candidates are expecting offers by Friday.

Attachments: Q3_gtm_hc_request_v2.xlsx; comp_band_exception_form.pdf

Next steps I need:
1) Approve headcount opens so recruiting can submit POs to Nexus Talent (we’re using them for expedited sourcing).
2) Approve the two comp-band exceptions (or advise alternate approval like sign-on or equity mix).
3) If partial approval, tell me which reqs to deprioritize (AE vs CS).

Thanks — trying to move fast on this one.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Sr. GTM Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quota-driven HC request + comp-band exceptions (Q3)

Priyom —

Thanks for the rundown and for pulling the numbers together. I am comfortable with opening the 2x SE and 1x AE reqs to recruiting immediately given the forecasted churn/risk. A couple of notes:

- Comp exceptions: prefer to avoid permanent band inflation where possible. For candidate A (the +$10k ask) can we structure as: offer at top of existing band + $10k sign-on (one-time) rather than raise the band? That preserves future calibration.
- For candidate B (+$7k) I can green-light a limited band uplift only if total comp remains within the HC budget in the workbook (line items look tight).
- CS Manager conversion: I’ll approve conditional on a 60-day plan for the role transition and quota coverage (we can revisit if SE pipeline changes).

Can finance confirm budget availability? I’d like a quick note from Rishi on the comp exceptions before final offers go out. If Rishi signs off, I’ll mark these as approved for recruiting to extend.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quota-driven HC request + comp-band exceptions (Q3) — FINAL APPROVAL

All —

After reviewing the workbook and speaking with finance, I approve the following:

1) Open headcount: 2x Senior SE (SE-342, SE-343) and 1x AE (AM-209) — recruiting can issue POs to Nexus Talent to start sourcing immediately.
2) Comp exceptions: approve one-time sign-on for candidate A (equivalent to the +$10k request) rather than a permanent band uplift. Deny the permanent band uplift for candidate B; if we still want to be competitive, authorize up to $5k sign-on for B but recruiting must get candidate commitment before offer.
3) CS Manager conversion: approve conditional (60-day transition plan required) — Priyom to circulate the plan by EOD Monday.

Please follow these operational steps before offers go out:
- Priyom: confirm total budget impact line in the workbook and update the Comp Exceptions tracker.
- Rishi: please confirm payroll/comp administration routing by Monday AM (cc: people-ops).
- Marissa: if any of the AE allocation can be reprioritized to CS quickly, note that in the workbook to avoid duplicate reqs.

I’m authorizing recruiting to extend offers under those terms. Priyom, loop Nexus Talent and have them hold candidate slots until we issue formal offers. I’m copying Nexus on this thread in case they need the final materials.

Attachments: approved_hc_po_emails.txt

— Laura
